statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for underlying paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
A 48-hour Holter monitor study (CPT 93226) was ordered
The monitor is intended to capture potential arrhythmic events
Diagnosis codes I49.9 and I48.0 are associated with this service
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
